intro: We'll introduce you to Spasa's story.
Spasa got her name because she was rescued. Before people adopted her, her fate was almost certainly death. People chose to give her a chance at life — a life she would otherwise have lost.

Every act of rescue carries weight. Choosing to respect and empathize with a being that feels, understands, and wants to live shows how responsible and good we can be — even when no one is obliged to act.
finalMessage: But there is something we owe: to leave all animals in peace.
